title: 5 Best Wireless Earbuds for iPhone, Android and Budgets
metaDescription: The best wireless earbuds for iPhone users, Android users, noise cancelling and tight budgets, with honest limitations.
lede: Earbuds work best with the phone they were designed for. These picks cover iPhone, Samsung and other Android phones, plus a strong budget option, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.

products.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3
products.blurb: Apple's noise-cancelling earbuds with Transparency mode, automatic switching between Apple devices and heart-rate sensing for workouts (Apple spec).
strengths: Seamless pairing and switching with Apple devices

products.name: Sony WF-1000XM5 Wireless Earbuds
products.searchQuery: Sony WF-1000XM5 wireless noise canceling earbuds
products.bestFor: Android users who want premium sound and noise cancelling
products.blurb: Sony's flagship noise-cancelling earbuds with support for the higher-bitrate LDAC codec on compatible Android phones and an app with a detailed equalizer.
limitations: Foam tips don't suit every ear

products.name: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen)
products.blurb: Bose's top noise-cancelling earbuds, designed for blocking out trains, planes and open offices, with a choice of ear tips and stability bands.
strengths: Among the strongest noise cancelling in earbuds
Works well with iPhone and Android
limitations: Larger case and buds than some rivals

products.name: Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro
products.blurb: Samsung's premium earbuds, with extra features such as seamless device switching and higher-quality audio when paired with Galaxy phones.
strengths: Best feature set with Galaxy phones

products.name: Soundcore Liberty 4 NC by Anker
products.blurb: A budget pair from Anker's Soundcore brand with active noise cancelling and app-based EQ, at a fraction of flagship prices.
strengths: Noise cancelling at a low price
limitations: Noise cancelling and call quality behind flagships

howWeChose: We matched earbuds to phones first, because ecosystem features matter more than small sound differences.
Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own listening tests.
Earbud models update often. Check the listing to make sure you're buying the model named here.
